description:
Execute a raw GAQL (Google Ads Query Language) query. Full flexibility for any reporting need.
Example: SELECT campaign.name, metrics.impressions FROM campaign WHERE campaign.status = 'ENABLED' AND segments.date DURING LAST_30_DAYS ORDER BY metrics.impressions DESC LIMIT 100

customerId.description: Google Ads customer ID (without dashes, e.g., 1234567890)

name: google_ads_run_gaql

result.description: Original tool result: parsed JSON when the text is JSON, otherwise the text or multiple MCP content blocks. Provider fields depend on the selected query.

title: google ads run gaql
